taint.sink: child_process.exec OS command with unlimited runtime/output

refs.note: bare express() with no rate-limit/timeout middleware

evidence: app/server.js:105 route receives req.query.foo; app/server.js:106 calls cprocess.exec(req.query.foo, callback) with no timeout/maxBuffer/killSignal options and no rate-limiting middleware (app/server.js:8 bare express()) | validator: app/server.js:105 GET /cwe78/childprocess unauthenticated; app/server.js:106 cprocess.exec(req.query.foo) shell-executes raw query with no allowlist or execFile | consensus: 1/1 confirmed
